summary.headline: RailTel Q2 FY27 operating revenue rose 28% QoQ to INR1,146 crore, but PAT grew only 4% QoQ to INR69 crore on INR32 crore ECL provision.
summary.overview: Management reported Q2 FY27 operating revenue of INR1,146 crore, up 28% QoQ from INR893 crore, with Telecom at INR397 crore and Projects at INR749 crore. Profit before tax before exceptional items was INR124 crore (up 29% QoQ), while reported PBT was INR92 crore and PAT INR69 crore, growing only 3% and 4% QoQ. The gap was attributed to an unusual expected credit loss (ECL) provision of about INR32 crore, mostly on government debtors. Order inflow in H1 FY27 was INR2,458 crore, taking the order book to INR12,282 crore.

financial_highlights.change: +28% QoQ from INR893 crore in Q1 FY27
+20% vs INR1,695 crore in H1 FY26
Described as unusually high, mainly government debtors
Strong growth per analyst; no YoY figure stated

segments.name: Telecom
segments.commentary: Q2 FY27 revenue INR397 crore. NLD at INR174 crore driven by an armed forces order from January 2026 and railway CCTV connectivity. ISP (RailWire) flat at INR110 crore YoY due to competition.

segments.name: Projects
segments.commentary: Q2 FY27 revenue INR749 crore. Railway order book about INR2,873 crore of the INR12,282 crore total. KAVACH expected to add INR50-100 crore in the current financial year.

segments.name: Data centre
segments.commentary: Management guides about INR300 crore revenue this year and INR500 crore next year. Includes a 10 MW Noida facility targeted for May 2027 and Edge data centres, two of the two commissioned last year are close to sold out.

guidance_outlook: Management is still hopeful of meeting the about INR3,500 crore execution target for the year from the order book, with about INR1,282 crore executed so far. Execution is expected to accelerate in H2.
Data centre revenue guided at about INR300 crore this year and INR500 crore next year. Management said the INR300 crore figure is assured.
Data centre margin expected at 8-10% at the bottom, with opex-based sharing with partners where used.
Two Edge data centres targeted for commissioning this financial year, versus about five planned earlier.
KAVACH financial progress expected at INR50-100 crore this year, with 2027-28 expected to be the major year for installations.
Management said visibility of substantial growth in operating income in coming quarters.
capex_capacity: 10 MW data centre in Noida: civil construction in final phases, expected to go live by May 2027.
Two Edge data centres commissioned last year, mostly sold out; two more targeted this financial year.
Edge data centre rollout slowed because demand has been below expectations and government bodies are building on-premise capacity.
Partner infrastructure tie-ups used where customers need immediate capacity, as compute and storage carry long lead times.
demand_pricing: Order book INR12,282 crore; H1 FY27 order inflow INR2,458 crore; railway share about INR2,873 crore.
Management cited growing demand for sovereign-controlled data centres after cyber incidents.
Edge data centre demand weaker than anticipated; Airtel and other players have entered the segment.
RailWire ISP revenue flat YoY because of competition.
No new international orders in the last two to three months; international bidding continues.

qa_highlights.question: Why did revenue grow about 28% QoQ while PAT grew only about 4%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed it to an unusual ECL provision of about INR32 crore on certain debtors. It said annual results would give a clearer picture, as quarterly numbers can be distorted by one-off items.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the INR3,500 crore execution target has been achieved?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR1,282 crore executed so far. Management expects H2 to be stronger, as it usually is, and still hopes to meet the target.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the Noida 10 MW data centre?
qa_highlights.answer: Civil work is in its final phases and the facility is targeted to go live by May 2027. Data centre revenue of INR300 crore is expected this year, of which the Noida facility is only part.

qa_highlights.question: What is the KAVACH and 4G/5G railway network outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: KAVACH is expected to add INR50-100 crore in the current year, with 2027-28 the main installation year. There has been no visible activity on the 700 MHz railway network rollout, with no RFPs or intents known.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the ECL provision higher, and is there a dispute?
qa_highlights.answer: All debtors are government entities and there are no disputes, only delays beyond normal. Provisions are made at 50% for recent dues and 75% for older dues, across multiple accounts.

qa_highlights.question: What margins are expected on data centre revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said margins are around 8-10% at the bottom, and that the INR300 crore target is assured. Revenue split between Noida 10 MW and Edge facilities was not given.

risks_watch: ECL of INR32 crore in Q2 could recur if government payment delays persist; the company reverses provisions when money is realised.
Data centre target of INR300 crore this year depends on the Noida facility going live by May 2027 and on customer ramp-up.
Edge data centre demand is weaker than planned and the target was cut from about five to two this year.
RailWire ISP revenue is flat, with competitive pressure.
Execution of INR3,500 crore target relies on H2 acceleration; only about INR1,282 crore was done in H1.
No visible progress on the 5G/4G railway network rollout.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the order book, data centre plans and H2 execution, but cautious and non-committal on KAVACH timing and the railway 5G rollout, and deflective on quarterly profit drivers, saying the year-end will show the clearer picture.

adds.what: Two Edge data centres targeted for commissioning this financial year (down from about five planned earlier)

growth.why: Management guides data centre revenue of about INR300 crore this year and INR500 crore next, with the INR300 crore called assured; order book of INR12,282 crore and H1 FY27 inflow of INR2,458 crore back the outlook, but the 10 MW Noida facility (May 2027) and two Edge DCs are the only concrete capacity, and Edge rollout was cut from about five to two.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Data centre margin guided at 8-10% at the bottom and PBT before exceptionals rose 29% QoQ to INR124 crore, but the INR32 crore ECL provision drags reported PBT to INR92 crore and recurrence is possible while government payment delays persist.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: 10 MW Noida data centre is in final civil construction phases and targeted to go live by May 2027, with two Edge DCs targeted this year, though Edge rollout was cut from about five to two.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Execution of INR1,282 crore done of the INR3,500 crore target in H1 with management expecting H2 acceleration, backed by a INR12,282 crore order book and H1 inflow of INR2,458 crore; H1 operating revenue grew 20% YoY to INR2,039 crore.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Data centre guidance of INR500 crore next year and sovereign DC demand could drive new capex, but no capex figure or board plan was disclosed and Edge demand is below expectations.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management still only hopes to meet the INR3,500 crore execution target with INR1,282 crore done in H1 (about 37%), and Edge target was cut, so no upgrade signal.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: INR3,500 crore execution needs H2 to deliver about INR2,218 crore, and Noida go-live by May 2027 is needed for the INR300 crore data centre target, while ECL risk and weak Edge demand persist.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Sovereign-controlled data centre demand is cited and KAVACH 2027-28 is the main installation year, but no specific new product launch was named.

rows.label: KAVACH installations ramp
rows.why: KAVACH expected to add INR50-100 crore this year with 2027-28 as the major installation year, though the 4G/5G railway network has no visible progress.

rows.label: Government receivables collection and ECL reversal
rows.why: INR32 crore ECL on government debtors (50% provision on recent dues, 75% on older) reverses when money is realised, so cash collection could lift reported profit.

rows.label: International bids
rows.why: No new international orders in the last two to three months, with bidding continuing but no wins to show.

tone.note: Management was confident on the order book, the INR300 crore data centre target and H2 execution, but cautious on KAVACH timing and the railway 5G rollout; analysts pressed on the ECL-driven gap between revenue and PAT and the deflective answers on quarterly profit drivers.
